description: Part of the UX team focused on improving digital experiences for city residents. I worked on UI systems, design proposals, component testing and alignment with established design guidelines.

SimpliCar provides digital solutions in the automotive sector. I led research, design, prototyping and testing of a SaaS for motorbike dealers to centralise sales and improve user access to full catalogues.

Grant Group is a startup based in Perth with projects in real estate, mining, cleaning services and skincare. I led the design and content team, overseeing branding and communication across sub-brands and creating websites such as ACOR Bookkeeping Solutions.

BlackSnake (AUST) is a Melbourne-based company that manufactures recovery ropes for industries such as mining, 4x4, military and agricultural. My goal was to create a platform where they could present their wide range of products, taking into account the complexity of product customisation.

Alphesda is a Melbourne-based agency dedicated to providing digital solutions to their clients, offering design, development, maintenance and enhancement of their websites in order to have a greater reach and engagement with their clients. My responsibilities included the creation of pages and components on client sites, development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, WordPress and Wix, adjustments to existing components and direct communication with clients.
